\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{কিনা} (kinā)}{কিনা (kinā)}]{\bn{কিনা} (kinā) — whether (or not)}

\label{lesson:BN-C369-kina}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for as long as, then the Bengali for or else.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{কিনা}}
\textbf{\bn{কিনা}} — \emph{kinā} — \textquotedblleft{}whether (or not)\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{অরুণ} \bn{আসবে} \bn{কিনা} \bn{জানি} \bn{না}; \bn{এলে} \bn{আমরা} \bn{একসঙ্গে} \bn{খাব।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{ôrun āsbe kinā jāni nā; ele āmrā eksôngge khābô.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
I don't know whether Arun will come; if he does, we'll eat together.
\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{কিনা}} (\emph{kinā}) is \bn{কি}, 'what, whether' (CDIAL 3164 lists Bengali ki), with \bn{না}, 'not': 'whether or not'. It comes after the verb it questions: \bn{আসবে} \bn{কিনা}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for saying what happens if.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{kinā}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{kinā}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{ôrun āsbe kinā jāni nā; ele āmrā eksôngge khābô.} — I don't know whether Arun will come; if he does, we'll eat together.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for as long as, then the Bengali for or else, then say \emph{kinā} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \bn{কিনা} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}Whether (or not)\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{এমনকি} (emônki)}{এমনকি (emônki)}]{\bn{এমনকি} (emônki) — even}

\label{lesson:BN-C369-emonki}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for or else, then the Bengali for whether.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{এমনকি}}
\textbf{\bn{এমনকি}} — \emph{emônki} — \textquotedblleft{}even\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{ঝড়} \bn{হলে} \bn{এমনকি} \bn{বাসও} \bn{বন্ধ} \bn{থাকে।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{jhôṛ hôle emônki bāso bôndhô thāke.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
When there is a storm, even the buses stop running.
\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{এমনকি}} (\emph{emônki}) is \bn{এমন}, 'such, so', with \bn{কি}, 'what' (CDIAL 3164 lists Bengali ki): 'is it even so?' The source of \bn{এমন} is not settled. The word marks the most surprising member of a list.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for saying what happens if.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{emônki}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{emônki}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{jhôṛ hôle emônki bāso bôndhô thāke.} — When there is a storm, even the buses stop running.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for or else, then the Bengali for whether, then say \emph{emônki} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \bn{এমনকি} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}Even\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{অন্যথায়} (ônyôthāy)}{অন্যথায় (ônyôthāy)}]{\bn{অন্যথায়} (ônyôthāy) — failing that; otherwise (formal)}

\label{lesson:BN-C369-onyothay}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for whether, then the Bengali for even.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{অন্যথায়}}
\textbf{\bn{অন্যথায়}} — \emph{ônyôthāy} — \textquotedblleft{}failing that; otherwise (formal)\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{যদি} \bn{সময়} \bn{থাকে}, \bn{তাহলে} \bn{আজ} \bn{এসো}, \bn{অন্যথায়} \bn{কাল} \bn{এসো।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{jôdi sômôy thāke, tāhôle āj eso, ônyôthāy kāl eso.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
If you have time, come today; failing that, come tomorrow.
\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{অন্যথায়}} (\emph{ônyôthāy}) is Sanskrit \emph{anyathā}, otherwise (Monier-Williams), with the Bengali ending -\bn{য়}. It is the formal partner of \bn{নাহলে}, common on notices and in letters.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for saying what happens if.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{ônyôthāy}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{ônyôthāy}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{jôdi sômôy thāke, tāhôle āj eso, ônyôthāy kāl eso.} — If you have time, come today; failing that, come tomorrow.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for whether, then the Bengali for even, then say \emph{ônyôthāy} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \bn{অন্যথায়} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}Failing that; otherwise (formal)\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{সত্ত্বেও} (sôttveo)}{সত্ত্বেও (sôttveo)}]{\bn{সত্ত্বেও} (sôttveo) — in spite of; despite}

\label{lesson:BN-C369-sottveo}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for even, then the Bengali for failing that.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{সত্ত্বেও}}
\textbf{\bn{সত্ত্বেও}} — \emph{sôttveo} — \textquotedblleft{}in spite of; despite\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{শীত} \bn{সত্ত্বেও} \bn{খেলা} \bn{হবে}, \bn{কিন্তু} \bn{ঝড়} \bn{হলে} \bn{বন্ধ} \bn{হবে।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{shīt sôttveo khælā hôbe, kintu jhôṛ hôle bôndhô hôbe.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
The match will go ahead despite the cold, but if there is a storm it will be called off.
\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{সত্ত্বেও}} (\emph{sôttveo}) is Sanskrit \emph{sattva}, being or existence (Monier-Williams), with the Bengali endings -\bn{এ} and -\bn{ও}: 'even with its being so'. The sense 'in spite of' is not one the dictionary gives; the word follows its noun: \bn{শীত} \bn{সত্ত্বেও}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for saying what happens if.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{sôttveo}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{sôttveo}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{shīt sôttveo khælā hôbe, kintu jhôṛ hôle bôndhô hôbe.} — The match will go ahead despite the cold, but if there is a storm it will be called off.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for even, then the Bengali for failing that, then say \emph{sôttveo} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \bn{সত্ত্বেও} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}In spite of; despite\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{নির্ধারণ} \bn{করা} (nirdhārôn kôrā)}{নির্ধারণ করা (nirdhārôn kôrā)}]{\bn{নির্ধারণ} \bn{করা} (nirdhārôn kôrā) — to determine; to fix (a date, a price)}

\label{lesson:BN-C369-nirdharon-kora}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for failing that, then the Bengali for in spite of.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{নির্ধারণ} \bn{করা}}
\textbf{\bn{নির্ধারণ} \bn{করা}} — \emph{nirdhārôn kôrā} — \textquotedblleft{}to determine; to fix (a date, a price)\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{আবহাওয়া} \bn{ভালো} \bn{থাকলে} \bn{আমরা} \bn{কাল} \bn{খেলার} \bn{তারিখ} \bn{নির্ধারণ} \bn{করব।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{ābôhāoyā bhālo thākle āmrā kāl khelār tārikh nirdhārôn kôrbô.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
If the weather stays fine, we'll fix the date of the match tomorrow.
\end{quote}

Past (he/she …): \bn{তিনি} \bn{দামটা} \bn{নির্ধারণ} \bn{করলেন}, \emph{tini dāmṭā nirdhārôn kôrlen}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{নির্ধারণ} \bn{করা}} (\emph{nirdhārôn kôrā}) is Sanskrit \emph{nirdhāraṇa}, settling or ascertaining (Monier-Williams), with \bn{করা}: to fix a date, a price or a rule.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for saying what happens if.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{nirdhārôn kôrā}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{nirdhārôn kôrā}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{ābôhāoyā bhālo thākle āmrā kāl khelār tārikh nirdhārôn kôrbô.} — If the weather stays fine, we'll fix the date of the match tomorrow.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for failing that, then the Bengali for in spite of, then say \emph{nirdhārôn kôrā} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \bn{নির্ধারণ} \bn{করা} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}To determine; to fix (a date, a price)\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.

\section[(dialogue)]{Looking back: from Making Sense of It to Whether or Not}

\label{lesson:BN-R369-review-362-369}



\begin{quote}
Say the Bengali for concentration and misled.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item concentration, misled, to realise, to sense, clear
  \item a problem, a means, an alternative, an answer, to come through
  \item difficult, a crisis, poverty, to be devastated, extreme
  \item a difference of opinion, an agreement reached, a settlement, to talk round, unanimous
  \item a likelihood, probably, inevitable, rare, to assume
  \item to suppose, to estimate, a hint, an expectation, the future
  \item a condition, a state of things, a situation, as long as, or else
  \item whether, even, failing that, in spite of, to determine
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Concentration? (\textbf{\bn{মনোযোগ}}, \emph{mônojog}.) Misled? (\textbf{\bn{বিভ্রান্ত}}, \emph{bibhrāntô}.) To realise? (\textbf{\bn{উপলব্ধি} \bn{করা}}, \emph{upôlôbdhi kôrā}.) To sense? (\textbf{\bn{বোধ} \bn{করা}}, \emph{bodh kôrā}.) Clear? (\textbf{\bn{স্পষ্ট}}, \emph{spôshṭô}.) A problem? (\textbf{\bn{সমস্যা}}, \emph{sômôsyā}.) A means? (\textbf{\bn{উপায়}}, \emph{upāy}.) An alternative? (\textbf{\bn{বিকল্প}}, \emph{bikôlpô}.) An answer? (\textbf{\bn{উত্তর}}, \emph{uttôr}.) To come through? (\textbf{\bn{উতরে} \bn{যাওয়া}}, \emph{utre jāoyā}.) Difficult? (\textbf{\bn{কঠিন}}, \emph{kôṭhin}.) A crisis? (\textbf{\bn{সংকট}}, \emph{sôngkôṭ}.) Poverty? (\textbf{\bn{দারিদ্র্য}}, \emph{dāridryô}.) To be devastated? (\textbf{\bn{বিপর্যস্ত} \bn{হওয়া}}, \emph{bipôrjôstô hôoyā}.) Extreme? (\textbf{\bn{চরম}}, \emph{chôrôm}.) A difference of opinion? (\textbf{\bn{মতভেদ}}, \emph{môtbhed}.) An agreement reached? (\textbf{\bn{সমঝোতা}}, \emph{sômjhotā}.) A settlement? (\textbf{\bn{নিষ্পত্তি}}, \emph{nishpôtti}.) To talk round? (\textbf{\bn{মানানো}}, \emph{mānāno}.) Unanimous? (\textbf{\bn{সর্বসম্মত}}, \emph{sôrbôsômmôtô}.) A likelihood? (\textbf{\bn{সম্ভাবনা}}, \emph{sômbhābônā}.) Probably? (\textbf{\bn{সম্ভবত}}, \emph{sômbhôbôtô}.) Inevitable? (\textbf{\bn{অনিবার্য}}, \emph{ônibārjô}.) Rare? (\textbf{\bn{বিরল}}, \emph{birôl}.) To assume? (\textbf{\bn{ধরে} \bn{নেওয়া}}, \emph{dhôre neoyā}.) To suppose? (\textbf{\bn{অনুমান} \bn{করা}}, \emph{ônumān kôrā}.) To estimate? (\textbf{\bn{আন্দাজ} \bn{করা}}, \emph{āndāj kôrā}.) A hint? (\textbf{\bn{আভাস}}, \emph{ābhās}.) An expectation? (\textbf{\bn{প্রত্যাশা}}, \emph{prôtyāshā}.) The future? (\textbf{\bn{ভবিষ্যৎ}}, \emph{bhôbishyôt}.) A condition? (\textbf{\bn{শর্ত}}, \emph{shôrtô}.) A state of things? (\textbf{\bn{অবস্থা}}, \emph{ôbôsthā}.) A situation? (\textbf{\bn{পরিস্থিতি}}, \emph{pôristhiti}.) As long as? (\textbf{\bn{যতক্ষণ}}, \emph{jôtôkkhôn}.) Or else? (\textbf{\bn{অথবা}}, \emph{ôthôbā}.) Whether? (\textbf{\bn{কিনা}}, \emph{kinā}.) Even? (\textbf{\bn{এমনকি}}, \emph{emônki}.) Failing that? (\textbf{\bn{অন্যথায়}}, \emph{ônyôthāy}.) In spite of? (\textbf{\bn{সত্ত্বেও}}, \emph{sôttveo}.) To determine? (\textbf{\bn{নির্ধারণ} \bn{করা}}, \emph{nirdhārôn kôrā}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
